prompt:
电商品牌与来源故事图。核心任务：帮助用户理解商品背后的品牌、来源、设计理念或制造背景。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与品牌资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据品牌与商品资料总结}。文案：{只使用用户提供的核对过的文案}。品牌 / 来源信息：{从用户资料、品牌资料或商品背景中提取}。故事重点：{筛选最有助于理解商品价值的真实内容}。其余叙事画面与视觉表达请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。

本次输入：【填写商品外观、图的用途、已核对的规格与可展示文案】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
E-commerce brand and origin story image. Core task: Help users understand the brand, origin, design philosophy, or production background behind the product. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and brand data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on brand and product data}. Copy: {Use only approved copy supplied by the user}. Brand / origin information: {Extracted from user data, brand assets, or product background}. Story focus: {Select authentic content that best communicates product value}. Autonomously design narrative visuals and artistic presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

Inputs: [Provide product appearance, purpose of the image, verified specifications, and approved copy].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
